description: This file defines a mock class 'MockIAuthenticate' for testing purposes, which implements the 'IAuthenticate' interface in the WPEFramework plugin host. The mock class uses Google Mock to simulate authentication-related methods such as querying interfaces, creating tokens, and releasing resources.

classes.name: MockIAuthenticate
classes.description: A mock implementation of the WPEFramework::PluginHost::IAuthenticate interface used for unit testing.

methods.name: QueryInterfaceByCallsign
methods.description: Mocks the method to query interface by callsign, returning a pointer.

methods.name: CreateToken
methods.description: Mocks token creation based on given parameters.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Mocks releasing resources, returning an operation status.

methods.name: QueryInterface
methods.description: Mocks querying an interface based on an ID.

methods.name: Officer
methods.description: Mocks obtaining a security interface given a token.
